name: Propose a club project
about: Propose a new work, exhibition, collaboration, or matchday
title: "Project proposal: "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

### Artistic idea and question
What could we create or explore? Whose visions might differ?

### The Utopian play
What do we propose to practise now, rather than only promise for later?

### Participants
Who has *actually opted in*? Who are we inviting? Keep these distinct.

### Resources and risks
Space, money, time, access, technical help, or other support; any known constraints.

### Decisions and permissions
Who would host or sign, and how would we agree on credit, rights, fees, budgets, and use of the club name before making commitments?

### First reversible step
What can we try without committing others?

### How we will learn
What useful result would we notice, and what might change our minds?
